hiveSql:
with tmp_date as (select t.sk_date,
                         ${beg_date}   as beg_date,
                         t.next_wkdate as end_date
                  from dw.dim_date t
                  where sk_date = ${end_date})
                        SELECT occu_dt, agmt_tnv_no, tnv_onum, prd_code, ast_unit_code, pfl_code, secu_id, pldg_secu_id, pldg_src_secu_id, prov_side, pldg_rati, pldg_vol, pldg_par_gamt, pldg_typ, inv_typ, busi_date, task_rs_id, dm_created_time, p_dt, sys_rs_id
                          FROM ${srcdbname}.evt_inbk_tnv_mort t
                          inner join tmp_date t1 on 1=1 
                          where t.p_dt between t1.beg_date and t1.end_date

preSql:
delete from evt_inbk_tnv_mort where p_dt in  (select b.sk_date
       from dim_date b,
            (select ${beg_date}   as beg_date,
                    a.next_wkdate as end_date
             from dim_date a
             where a.sk_date = ${end_date}) c
       where b.sk_date between c.beg_date and c.end_date)
